verdict.rationale: Mollie's v2 APIs let merchants accept payments in local currencies beyond EUR (mollie-docs-12), and Settlement Reports plus the Balances API support reconciling payouts (mollie-docs-10, mollie-docs-11). However, the evidence does not document how multi-currency amounts are converted to the founder's settlement currency, what FX rates/markups are applied, or any explicit 'transparent FX' disclosure/fee schedule. missing for 10: documented FX conversion mechanics, exchange-rate source/markup transparency, explicit settlement-currency selection behavior, and independent confirmation of FX fee transparency.
